scientific_rules: Missing data in NASA FLAME does not prove that NASA never conducted an experiment.
Distinguish missing measurements from unavailable source files.
Classification 'confirmed_missing' indicates that this parameter was omitted from the flight telemetry sensor suite or flight test matrix.
Unprocessed raw spreadsheet files exist in the repository (e.g. Kapton, Teflon, Silicone) that have not yet been normalized into the active catalog.
External NASA PSI investigations (e.g. FLEX droplet combustion, ACME gaseous burner flames) are outside the scope of FLAME's current 11 processed datasets.

investigation_names: BASS-II (Burning and Suppression of Solids - II)

temperature.sensor_technology: K-type thermocouple arrays (plume, sample, inlet, avionics)
temperature.notes: Saffire features 12 calibrated thermocouple channels (Plume 1-6, Sample 1-6) at 30.3 Hz. BASS-II discrete run matrix omitted continuous thermocouple time series.

pressure.notes: Saffire measures ambient pressure around 14.7 PSIA (~101.3 kPa). Cygnus telemetry logs PCM pressure channels (EPS 1, 2, 3). BASS-II operated in standard ISS cabin, but discrete pressure was not recorded per run.

radiant_heat_flux.notes: Saffire records 4 calibrated broadband radiometers in mw/cm² (1 mw/cm² = 0.01 kW/m²). BASS-II primary test matrix omitted calibrated physical heat flux (only electrical amplifier gain factor was logged).

radiometer_amplifier_gain.notes: BASS-II logs electrical amplifier gain setting (10, 50, 250, 1000). Not a physical heat flux reading; distinct from calibrated W/m².

flow_velocity.sensor_technology: Hot-film / vane anemometers and duct fan tachometers
flow_velocity.notes: Saffire includes dual anemometers (cm/sec) and fan tachometer (RPM). BASS-II characterizes flow via physical restrictor plates (1, 2, 3) and digital fan displays.

oxygen_concentration.notes: Continuous 30.3 Hz O2 channel in Saffire. Initial and final calibrated O2 % by vol recorded across all 129 BASS-II runs.

carbon_dioxide_concentration.notes: Continuous CO2 % in Saffire duct. Initial and final CO2 % by vol in BASS-II.

carbon_monoxide_concentration.notes: BASS-II logs initial and final CO in ppm. Saffire flight hardware did NOT include a CO sensor in the duct flow instrumentation.

smoke_obscuration.notes: Measures cabin smoke accumulation aboard Cygnus resupply vehicle. Not part of local combustion chamber instrumentation.

flame_spread_rate.sensor_technology: Derived measurement: Optical high-speed video tracking and thermocouple isotherm arrival analysis
flame_spread_rate.notes: Flame spread rate is a DERIVED parameter. It is not recorded as a direct raw sensor channel in Saffire telemetry or the primary BASS-II spreadsheet, requiring video image processing or analytical isotherm tracking.

extinction_time.sensor_technology: Derived from thermal decay analysis, gas sensor plateaus, and optical camera confirmation
extinction_time.notes: Saffire Sample 1 sustained combustion throughout 689.96s recording. Sample 2 exhibited flame extinction at ~155s verified by thermocouple cooling and video records.

fuel_moisture_content.notes: Fabric sample moisture pre-conditioning was managed at launch but individual pre-flight moisture percentage was omitted from flight telemetry and matrix sheets.

video_frames.sensor_technology: Visible and infrared high-speed video cameras
video_frames.notes: BASS-II logs 'total frames shot' per run. Saffire records Camera 1/2 triggers and DIO control pulses at 30.3 Hz.
